description: This file defines the 'TimesheetItem' class as part of the OrangeHRM system, representing individual entries within a timesheet, including properties such as date, duration, comment, and relationships to other entities like Timesheet, Project, ProjectActivity, and Employee.

classes.name: TimesheetItem
classes.description: Entity class representing a timesheet item with properties such as date, duration, comment, and links to related entities. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter and setter methods for each property.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the timesheet item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the timesheet item.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date associated with this timesheet entry.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date for this timesheet entry.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the timesheet item in seconds.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for this timesheet item.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns any comment associated with this timesheet item.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for this timesheet item.

methods.name: setTimesheet
methods.description: Associates a Timesheet entity with this item.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with this item.

methods.name: setProjectActivity
methods.description: Associates a ProjectActivity entity with this item.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee entity associated with this timesheet item.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this timesheet item.
